jobs.title: .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Team**

Sportcast is widely recognized as the leader in sports betting player engagement through their product experiences, technologies and pricing. We invented BetBuilder, and our award-winning original continues to pioneer sports betting experiences. Billions of combinations, within single sporting events, immerse players deeply in the story they build. Players want more. More access to every possible betting opportunity, every event combination, for every sport. Thrilling betting moments. Created by players. Now part of OpenBet. We've brought together the developers, statisticians, data scientists powering the future of sports betting. They build the odds and prices for billions – and soon trillions - of game eventualities. The ultimate features. Any combination. Every sports story.

**SportCast x OpenBet** is a team that you want to be part of! Come join us.

We are looking for a passionate **.Net Software Engineer** to support Sportcast's growth from our European offices.

As a Software Developer in the Trade team, you will work as part of a cross-functional team that develops, deploys, and supports its own projects and outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work on varied projects to write testable and maintainable code. Being a team player, you will enjoy participating in team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions. These teams' focus is to assist the business in delivering scaling while also maintaining high quality.

The role will involve the development and maintenance of our real-time systems.

**What you will be doing**

* Develop high quality, high-performing code which meets the business need.
* Optimise our solutions to ensure we support our service levels and minimise cloud costs.
* Automate processes wherever possible.
* Challenge the status quo. Help improve our patterns, standards and procedures across the organisation.

**The Player**

* 3+ years of experience with .NET/.NET Core and C#
* Exposure to Unit Testing, Serverless technologies such as Azure Functions, and containerized microservices using Azure Container Apps or AWS equivalents
* Expertise in SQL-based databases including MSSQL and PostgreSQL
* Experience with GitHub/ GitFlow workflow branch strategy
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Effective team player in cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams, with a strong collaborative mindset
* Strategic and resourceful problem solver, focused on delivering secure, scalable, and value-driven solutions iteratively
* Exposure to high-volume, mission-critical systems with performance and reliability requirements
* Prior experience in the wagering or gaming industry is a plus

**What’s the Score?**

**What We Can Offer YOU**

* We have a collaborative hybrid office environment with our team members at least 3 days per week.
* Attractive benefits, an open and supportive environment as well as a modern and exciting workplace
* The opportunity to interact with global teams on a regular basis as you and our business continues to develop & grow
* Tangible and genuine development - at OpenBet, you can take your career where you want it to go!
* And if that’s not enough; enjoy flexible working whilst we provide you with the guidance and development skills you need to progress and enhance your career

At OpenBet, we celebrate diversity and believe in creating an inclusive environment where every voice is valued and respected. We're committed to building a team that reflects the rich tapestry of humanity, embracing individuals from all walks of life, backgrounds, and identities. Join us in shaping the future of iGaming, where diversity isn't just celebrated—it's celebrated.

jobs.title: Senior AVEVA System Platform / OMI Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Vos missions**

Great assignments await you with our key account clients in rich and varied environments

We are looking for a **Senior AVEVA System Platform / OMI Solution Expert** to join a development team responsible for a business-critical 24/7 SCADA environment supporting the real-time balancing of power assets and ancillary services across multiple European countries. The mission is part of a strategic transformation program aimed at implementing a new standardized SCADA platform based on **AVEVA System Platform / OMI** for real-time control, monitoring, and automation of industrial assets.

The consultant will play a key role in designing, developing, configuring, testing, integrating, and supporting SCADA applications used for Power Dispatch, Energy Management, Remote Dispatching Centers, renewable assets, Battery Energy Storage Systems, and interactions with Transmission System Operators. The role requires a strong hands-on engineering mindset, combining technical expertise, operational support, troubleshooting capabilities, and close collaboration with business and operational stakeholders in a critical real-time environment.

Your missions:

* Contribute to the implementation of a new generation SCADA platform based on AVEVA System Platform / OMI.
* Design and deliver solutions supporting real-time operational decision-making.
* Develop and maintain production-ready SCADA applications.
* Translate operational and business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
* Support the integration of renewable energy assets, flexible assets, and Battery Energy Storage Systems.
* Ensure system compliance with group-wide harmonization and standardization objectives.
* Support the automation of processes required for ancillary services delivery.
* Participate in all project phases from technical analysis to production deployment.
* Provide operational support and contribute to incident resolution in a 24/7 operational environment.
* Collaborate with dispatchers, analysts, developers, and operational teams to continuously improve the platform.
  

Your activities:

Development & Configuration

* Develop, test, maintain, and enhance applications based on AVEVA System Platform.
* Implement and maintain ArchestrA object templates and instances.
* Develop OMI visualization content and operator interfaces.
* Create, maintain, and optimize ASP scripts.
* Configure industrial objects and data acquisition structures.
* Participate in software design and architecture discussions.
* Contribute to workload estimations and implementation planning.

Testing & Validation

* Execute functional testing activities.
* Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT).
* Support Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
* Validate software modifications before deployment.
* Troubleshoot issues identified during commissioning phases.
* Contribute to defect analysis, resolution, and product quality improvements.

Integration & Operations

* Configure and maintain AVEVA System Platform environments.
* Configure and maintain Historian integrations.
* Integrate communication protocols and industrial interfaces.
* Implement and support OPC DA, OPC UA, OPC XML communication layers.
* Implement and support Modbus TCP and Modbus Serial communications.
* Implement and support IEC-104 integrations.
* Perform troubleshooting and log analysis.
* Support production operations and incident resolution.
* Maintain system reliability, availability, and operational continuity.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

* Work closely with dispatchers, analysts, developers, and operational teams.
* Participate in Agile and SAFe ceremonies.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Share technical expertise, best practices, and lessons learned within the team.

You have the following skills:

Functional & Domain Expertise

* Industrial SCADA systems.
* Real-time operational platforms.
* Energy management environments.
* Remote dispatching and control centers.
* Ancillary services mechanisms (FCR, aFRR, mFRR, MVAr).
* Renewable energy integration.
* Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
* Production support in critical operational environments.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* AVEVA System Platform.
* AVEVA OMI.
* ArchestrA Object Modelling.
* ASP Scripting.
* Application troubleshooting.

Technical Experience

* AVEVA Application Server.
* Industrial SCADA development and maintenance.
* High Availability environments.
* Historian integration.
* OPC DA / OPC UA / OPC XML.
* Modbus TCP.
* Modbus Serial.
* IEC-104.
* Industrial communication protocols.
* IP network diagnostics.
* Industrial cybersecurity.
* Production incident management and support.

Education & Experience

* Master's degree in IT, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Electromechanics, or equivalent engineering discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform in industrial production environments.
* Proven experience in development and maintenance of operational SCADA platforms.
* Experience working directly with operational teams.
* Experience gained with AVEVA, AVEVA-certified organizations, AVEVA ecosystem partners, or equivalent organizations is considered an asset.

Soft Skills

* Strong implementation and delivery mindset.
* Autonomous and proactive.
* Team-oriented.
* Solution-driven attitude.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable in critical operational environments.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Focus on delivering reliable and maintainable solutions.

Additional Requirements

* Driving license required.
* Ability to work in a hybrid model with a minimum presence of 3 days per week on-site.

#### **Votre profil**

* You have at least 5 years of professional experiences in IT
* If you are at least fluent in FR/ENG or NL/ENG it’s best
* You’re eager to learn, motivated and curious
* Let’s have a chat !

#### **Advantages**

* Hospitalization insurance (partner/children incl.)
* Group insurance
* Dental insurance (partner/children included)
* 20 days statutory paid vacations (legal vacations cumulated for 1 year of work)
* 11 days recovery time work 38/40 per year (= annual average: 1 day per 20 days worked) if the client asks you to work 8h/day
* Representation fee net per month.
* Internet fee of € 40 per month.
* Company car with national fuel card OR Public transport reimbursed OR mobility package.
* Daily fee of 5.50€ net /day provided.
* Subscription GSM unlimited calls for Belgium (ITS subscription)
* Training plan (e-learning - certification at ITS charge)

**Extra advantages:**

* Being a rather small team in BE (6 in back-office), we’re very close to each of our consultants and we differentiate ourselves trying to really take care of you and make you grow with us and within our different clients.
* Regular follow-up (every 3 to 6months depending on your needs/will)
* Regular teambuilding to meet-up and have fun (every 3 months more or less)
* Flexibility and trust
* Benefits of still being part to a bigger group (ITS Group) and having access to resources and of a larger team of Experts
* Co-optation system because sharing is caring!

#### **Processus de recrutement**

* 1st pre-screening on the phone to discuss about your search and conditions and our first potential opportunities matching.
* Job descriptions sent and Teams meeting fixed with us (HR and Sales) to dig into your experience and the role.
* Package proposal so we all agree beforehand.
* Your CV is sent to the different clients you’ve agreed to, to find the best mission for you!

jobs.title: Full-Stack Analist-Developer
jobs.description:
Beschrijving

**Functie**
-----------

De Supporting Services departementen vormen een belangrijke basis voor de verdere groei van de bank. HR, Finance, Risk, Audit, Legal, Compliance, Logistics, Tax/Fiscal en het Transformation Office hebben elk hun eigen ambities, processen en ontwikkelingsnoden.

Als Full-Stack Solution Engineer werk je in een nieuw, compact development team. Op basis van de business requirements die door de Business Analyst worden voorbereid, verfijn je de functionele analyse en ontwikkel je de oplossing. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met business stakeholders en neemt end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid, van analyse en implementatie tot release, monitoring en support.

**Verantwoordelijkheden**
-------------------------

**Functionele analyse en solution shaping**

* Vertaal business requirements naar duidelijke functionele specificaties, user flows en implementeerbare oplossingscomponenten.
* Verduidelijk noden en edge cases samen met de Business Analyst, Subject Matter Experts en eindgebruikers.
* Draag constructief bij aan scope, haalbaarheid en oplossingskeuzes binnen de architecturale richting van het domein.

**Full-stack development en kwaliteit**

* Ontwikkel onderhoudbare, veilige en schaalbare applicaties met C#, .NET, Angular en TypeScript.
* Pas degelijke engineering practices toe op vlak van coding, review, documentatie en kwaliteitsborging.
* Gebruik GitHub en GitHub Copilot actief om samenwerking, consistentie en AI-ondersteunde development te bevorderen.

**Delivery en operationele ownership**

* Deploy applicaties via de beschikbare standaard release structuren en templates.
* Monitor, ondersteun en verbeter je applicaties na release: you build it, you run it.
* Onderzoek incidenten en feedback, en vertaal ze naar duurzame verbeteringen.

**AI-enabled oplossingen en samenwerking**

* Integreer AI capabilities in business oplossingen door gebruik te maken van het interne AI platform en de herbruikbare services ervan.
* Werk nauw samen met de Senior Full-Stack Developer & Solution Architect, de Business Analyst en de Domain Architect.
* Deel kennis en herbruikbare patterns naarmate de Supporting Services development capability groeit.

**Profiel**
-----------

We zoeken een medior of senior full-stack engineer die functionele analyse combineert met hands-on development en die zich comfortabel voelt bij het opnemen van ownership in een nieuw team.

Je hebt een stevige ervaring met C#, .NET, Angular, TypeScript en GitHub. Affiniteit met AI is essentieel, zowel voor het integreren van AI-functionaliteit als voor het gebruik van tools zoals GitHub Copilot in je dagelijkse engineeringwerk. Ervaring met API's of applicatie-integratie is een troef. Kennis van een of meerdere Supporting Services domeinen is een plus.

**Competenties**
----------------

Je bent een analytische, hands-on professional die het leuk vindt om business noden om te zetten naar betrouwbare software.

* Analyse en communicatie: je structureert complexe noden en communiceert helder met zowel business- als IT-stakeholders.
* Engineering quality: je hecht belang aan onderhoudbaarheid, beveiliging, kwaliteitsborging en operationele stabiliteit.
* Ownership: je werkt zelfstandig, maakt voortgang zichtbaar en blijft verantwoordelijk na go-live.
* Samenwerking: je werkt als één team met je collega-developer en zoekt actief feedback en domeinkennis op.
* Learning mindset: je neemt nieuwe technologie pragmatisch op en gebruikt AI om zowel oplossingen als manieren van werken te verbeteren.

**Positionering binnen de organisatie**
---------------------------------------

De Full-Stack Solution Engineer rapporteert binnen het Supporting Services domein en:

* werkt nauw samen met de Business Analyst om business requirements te verfijnen tot functionele specificaties;
* werkt samen met de Senior Full-Stack Developer & Solution Architect op vlak van solution design en implementatie;
* stemt af met de Domain Architect over architecturale principes en belangrijke technische keuzes;
* werkt rechtstreeks samen met Subject Matter Experts en stakeholders binnen Supporting Services.
